The City delivers undisinfected effluent to nearby lands via subsurface purple pipe for recycled water projects.

McCarthy Family Farms, Inc. discharges sludge from the WWTF at its facility in Corcoran as an enrollee under WDRs Order 95-140, Waste Discharge Requirements General Order for Reuse of Biosolids and Septage on Agricultural, Forest, and Reclamation Sites.
